tool_args.rationale: The branch probe added one low-gradient point, but no matched input–gradient contrast and no observation near the proposed onset. All six rows already match the forecast horizon. The trajectory batch is the remaining relevant probe for distinguishing smooth suppression from an additional sink before submitting a model.

considered_alternatives.option: Below-threshold branch of the recalled avalanche law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All six gradients are below its proposed onset, and even an unconstrained fit of its three active terms gives training RMSE about 0.137, above the 0.045 tolerance.
Each input is paired with only one gradient. A fit can trade off input saturation against gradient suppression without resolving how they interact on fresh rows.
The auxiliary reading does not separate input saturation from gradient suppression.
